run.name: useroptions restore
run.sql: SET NOCOUNT OFF; SET XACT_ABORT OFF; SET DATEFIRST 7; DBCC USEROPTIONS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count

run.name: useroptions inside a transaction
run.sql: BEGIN TRAN; DBCC USEROPTIONS; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count; COMMIT
